purpose: Consolidate repeated notation definitions while retaining every local stroke attestation; no page text is modified.

groups.meaning: ϕ : l’ensemble vide. The crossed-loop source glyph is retained
Written shorthand for même or mêmes in context, including the literal compounds lui-= and de =; the sign remains unexpanded in the transcription
Two upright strokes. They identify vertically stacked expressions in the cited diagrams and formulas; the pair in the margin of 150_scan013 is emphasis. Neither use is turned into a horizontal sign
Vertical identification with a curved upright on the left and a straight upright on the right; no directed shaft. The reversed local order on 150_scan017 has its own entry
Literal pairs of upper quotation ticks, retained as straight double quotation marks rather than guillemets; local uncertain closing ticks remain marked
Present unreadable mathematical ink with no recoverable candidate, never a blank. The adjacent transcription comment states its position and any unresolved source state
The specified boundary called bord, indicated by a separate filled point above T; this notation does not silently assert equality with an ambient topological frontier
Heavy serif form of the multiplicative interval/action parameter, explicitly defined as [0,1] on 150_scan012. The local thin and double-stem forms are recorded separately

Cone or neighborhood object, with locally written primes, radial parameters, dotted boundaries and the circled part used in the exterior construction. Ordinary T has its own roof only; a separately written bar is not supplied. Indexed families retain their local indices
The extra zero-image equality used for strict conical subspaces and in the comparison with cylindrical compatibility; source multiplication points and primes are retained
